data.notes: August 2026 is unusually strong for Toronto: Carnival weekend and VELD open the month, while Rogers Stadium and Scotiabank Arena carry several major stadium/arena runs later on.

events.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN TORONTO
events.summary: Ticketmaster’s Rogers Stadium schedule lists BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN TORONTO on Saturday, August 22 and Sunday, August 23, 2026 at 8:00 PM. The two-night stadium run is a global pop flagship for the month.

events.title: Toronto Caribbean Carnival Grand Parade
events.summary: The official Toronto Caribbean Carnival site lists the Grand Parade for August 1, 2026 at Exhibition Place and Lake Shore Blvd. The Carnival is a flagship Caribbean culture and music event with Mas bands, parade music and related live performances across the city.

events.title: VELD Music Festival
events.summary: VELD’s official lineup page confirms the festival at Downsview Park for July 31, August 1 and August 2, 2026. The event is Toronto’s major large-scale electronic festival weekend.

events.title: RUSH — Fifty Something
events.summary: Ticketmaster lists RUSH’s Fifty Something run at Scotiabank Arena on August 7, 9, 11 and 13, 2026. The four-night Toronto arena stand is one of the month’s most significant hometown rock events.

events.title: Ed Sheeran — LOOP Tour
events.summary: Ticketmaster lists Ed Sheeran’s LOOP Tour at Rogers Centre on Thursday, August 20, 2026 at 5:30 PM. It is a major stadium date on his 2026 tour routing.

events.title: Foo Fighters — Take Cover Tour 2026
events.summary: Live Nation lists Foo Fighters at Rogers Stadium on Tuesday, August 4, 2026 at 5:30 PM. The bill also includes Queens of the Stone Age and Mannequin Pussy.

events.title: The R&B Tour — Usher Raymond & Chris Brown
events.summary: Live Nation lists The R&B Tour starring Usher Raymond and Chris Brown at Rogers Stadium on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, with an additional nearby Rogers Stadium show on Wednesday, August 12. This is a two-night stadium-scale R&B bill.

events.title: Guns N’ Roses — World Tour 2026
events.summary: Ticketmaster lists Guns N’ Roses at Rogers Stadium in Toronto on Wednesday, August 5, 2026 at 6:25 PM. Public Enemy is listed on the Toronto lineup.

events.title: CNE Bell SOUNDSTAGE at the Bandshell
events.summary: The CNE’s official Bell SOUNDSTAGE page confirms the 2026 program runs August 21 to September 7, 2026, with performances free with admission to the fair. It anchors the CNE’s live-music programming at Bandshell Park.

events.title: Carnival Playground — AYETIAN Live
events.summary: A major Caribana Sunday blocko/day party at REBEL with a live AYETIAN performance, billed as a yearly sell-out indoor/outdoor Carnival event.

events.title: Daniel Caesar — Son of Spergy Tour
events.summary: Scotiabank Arena lists Daniel Caesar’s Son of Spergy Tour for Sunday, August 2, 2026 at 7:30 PM. The Toronto R&B artist returns for an arena-scale hometown date.

events.title: Afro-Carib Fest 2026
events.summary: The 15th annual Afro-Carib Fest returns to Scarborough with a large free weekend of African and Caribbean culture, live performances, DJs, dance, food, and community programming.

events.title: First Class Fest
events.summary: The Bowl at Sobeys Stadium confirms First Class Fest for Friday, August 28 and Saturday, August 29, 2026, with doors at 4:00 PM and show at 5:00 PM. The event is billed as an underground rap-focused festival weekend.

events.title: AFROFEST 2026
events.summary: Toronto’s long-running African music and culture festival returns to Woodbine Park for an August weekend, anchoring the city’s African-diaspora live-music calendar.

events.title: Rhythm Open Air: Minimal & Tech House
events.summary: Rhythm’s summer open-air series closes with a minimal and tech-house edition at 131 McCormack St, part of a new independent outdoor dance-music platform for Toronto.

events.title: Caribana Boat Party Toronto 2026
events.summary: A 500+ guest Caribana harbour cruise with rooftop dancing and DJs playing Soca, Dancehall, Afrobeats, Hip Hop, Reggaeton, and throwbacks.

events.title: Volen Sentir: Sunset Rooftop Party
events.summary: Plainsight.Live brings Volen Sentir to Open Aera for a sunset rooftop session of deep, atmospheric house, supported by Jonathan Rosa and R8YZ.

events.title: STAMPED: AYA x Friends — Toronto Caribana Edition
events.summary: MANLIKEAYA brings the STAMPED party back to Toronto for a Caribana day party focused on Afrobeats, Amapiano, and continental African sounds at Lavelle.

events.title: Eric Luttrell: Summer of Love Tour
events.summary: Anjunadeep staple Luttrell returns to Toronto for a daytime progressive/deep-house event at Open Aera as part of the Summer of Love Tour.

events.title: Carnival Playground — AYETIAN Live | Toronto Caribana Sunday
events.summary: TicketGateway lists Carnival Playground at REBEL on August 2, 2026, from 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM, with a live performance by AYETIAN. It is positioned as a Caribana Sunday day party at one of Toronto’s largest nightlife venues.
